units.text: Use the program ⟦0⟧ to compare three files and show any differences among them. (⟦1⟧ can also merge files; see ⟦2⟧Merging From a Common Ancestor⟦3⟧).
units.sourceHTML: Use the program diff3 to compare three files and show any differences among them. (diff3 can also merge files; see Merging From a Common Ancestor).

units.text: The “normal” ⟦0⟧ output format shows each hunk of differences without surrounding context. Hunks are labeled depending on whether they are two-way or three-way, and lines are annotated by their location in the input files.
units.sourceHTML: The “normal” diff3 output format shows each hunk of differences without surrounding context. Hunks are labeled depending on whether they are two-way or three-way, and lines are annotated by their location in the input files.

units.text: See ⟦0⟧Invoking ⟦1⟧⟦2⟧, for more information on how to run ⟦3⟧.
units.sourceHTML: See Invoking diff3, for more information on how to run diff3.
